_comment: Test logins for checking what each role sees. Sign in on the normal login page with one of these usernames and the shared password from PEOPLEOPS_TEST_PASSWORD in .env (no password set = test logins disabled). Each login resolves its role and scope from the employee id exactly like a real SSO sign-in, via access_control.resolve_identity + data/role-overrides.json. Keys are usernames (lowercase), values are employee ids from data/org-hierarchy.json.
